summary: Return service unavailable for transient usage ingestion storage failures

delivery.outcome: Publish the existing USAGE-STORAGE-001 response as HTTP503 for failed usage ingestion through protected OneDev and independent Validator delivery. Require an explicitly opted-in isolated PostgreSQL fixture during validation instead of implicit shared runtime database access.
nonGoals: No telemetry retries, provider replay, routing, credentials, dependencies or running service changes.

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing query storage-error classification in the HTTP command handler.
interfaceChanges: Existing usage-ingestion storage failure uses HTTP503 consistently with the usage-query endpoint.
architecture.rollback: Revert the exact error-status fix through protected publication.

validation.evidence: Isolated HTTP regression for failed storage, recovery, and unchanged malformed-input rejection.
Managed governance, stack validation and independent exact-head protected CI.

Unset test opt-in disables implicit local/shared application PostgreSQL; explicit malformed, remote and non-test targets fail before connecting; full suite exercises an owned disposable PostgreSQL fixture.
